subject.title: Skill-draft semantic dedup: duplicate drafts with different hash suffixes

question: Should Skill Research/Workshop coalesce similar pending proposals beyond exact skillKey matches, and should that use deterministic normalized content or embedding-threshold duplicate counters?
rationale: Current code has a narrow same-skill-key guard, while the requested semantic dedup changes novelty semantics, persisted metadata, and review workflow behavior.

options.title: Add deterministic novelty identity
options.body: Use a maintainer-approved normalized skillKey and proposal-content fingerprint to coalesce obvious duplicates without adding embedding infrastructure first.

options.title: Keep exact skillKey behavior
options.body: Treat broader semantic coalescing as not planned and close the issue after documenting that Skill Workshop only suppresses active same-skill proposals.

options.title: Add embedding similarity counters
options.body: Implement the reporter's threshold-and-counter design, accepting new persistence and tuning complexity for broader semantic matching.

recommendation.title: Add deterministic novelty identity
recommendation.body: Use a maintainer-approved normalized skillKey and proposal-content fingerprint to coalesce obvious duplicates without adding embedding infrastructure first.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Skill Workshop product-surface commits make this the best available owner for the novelty-policy decision.
